name: Image Content Viewer
description: Viewer for persisted image content with metadata editing and download. Ephemeral cell that displays images, allows editing tags/description/name, and provides download and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral (not persisted)

content_id.description: UUID of the persisted content to display

relative_url.description: Relative URL for direct file serving via Runtime File Server (e.g. /runtime/user/.../file.png)

_discovery.describe: Ephemeral cell for viewing persisted image content. Supports image display via content_id or relative_url, inline metadata editing (tags, description, name) via PATCH /api/contents/{id}, download via postMessage FILE_DOWNLOAD, and clipboard copy. Integrates with PNG Generator Cell through CellFactory.addChildCell().
use_cases: View persisted image content after PNG generation
